en: What do you think of the work on these shoes?
Wouldn't you like to wear shoes like these?
Oh, right, come by our place sometime.
I've got things I could show you there,
all sorts of them.
Shoes are only shoes when they're worn.
Just sitting on display like works of art...
that's not what they're for.
Hwaah... Huh?
This presence
Could it be
the elves are doing my work again?
I'm afraid not
But don't be sad. From now on, you won't
have to make shoes anymore
Waagh
What are you doing
Stop it!
Guhh
I'll put your skills to good use.
You never did make me any shoes, though.
Now, whatever you wish
Now what's this wound?
Medicine costs money. What a waste.
Master, what is your bidding
I just can't seem to shake this tiredness.
Am I sick? Ugh, I hate it, I hate it.
Hm? Who are you?
Have you been in my shop before or something?
No, this is my first visit.
You keep a shop here, do you?
Can't you tell by looking? What a dozy fellow.
It's a clock shop. You want to buy a clock?
I've got fine timepieces just right for you.
Ah, I see... Some other time, then.
I have no money with me at present.
What, you've got no money?
I've no time for window-shoppers.
Come back when you're ready to buy.
Do you remember me?
I've forgotten. Sorry about that.
You didn't buy a clock off me, did you?
Folks who buy from me, I remember.
Window-shoppers aren't welcome here.
What, you again?
Don't go hanging around here so much.
Speaking of hanging around, that young pup at the clock workshop!
He picks fights with me at every turn,
the cheeky upstart. What's his problem?
He's full of himself, that's what.
Don't you buy any clock he made.
He'd put the hands on backwards, that one.
Yes, welcome.
What brings you here today?
Show me your clocks.
It is poor form to only ever browse.
Oh? Is that so? Well, is that so, sir!
Please, please, we have all sorts.
Our selection is our pride, you see.
Plenty of high-class clocks, too.
Why, for a customer who pays well,
I'll bring out goods as fine as you please.
(Hmph, so this human's head is full of
nothing but money...)
Why, welcome.
Thank you kindly for last time.
Do keep coming back, heh heh heh
You made a good buy, friend.
Buying a clock here is always the better deal.
What is it? Who are you?
You're hardly here to shop at this hour.
Come back later.
It's my mealtime. Come back later.
Come by my clock shop later, eh.
Don't go running off to that clock workshop.
They might sell you a broken clock.
I said later. Didn't you hear me?
Ah, what is it? How's your clock running?
If you want a new one, I'll help you out.
